title: UCA configuration (uca/1)
description: Board, profile, theme and app.yaml files. Generated from the Rust types in uca-config; do not edit.

key.tap.description: A key name: a W3C code in any case (KeyA, F13) or an alias (q, shift, enter).

key.down.description: A key name: a W3C code in any case (KeyA, F13) or an alias (q, shift, enter).

key.up.description: A key name: a W3C code in any case (KeyA, F13) or an alias (q, shift, enter).

key.hold.description: A key name: a W3C code in any case (KeyA, F13) or an alias (q, shift, enter).

key.release.description: A key name: a W3C code in any case (KeyA, F13) or an alias (q, shift, enter).

key.toggle.description: A key name: a W3C code in any case (KeyA, F13) or an alias (q, shift, enter).

key.latch.description: A key name: a W3C code in any case (KeyA, F13) or an alias (q, shift, enter).

monitor.description: primary, a monitor index, or a monitor name.

ActionSeq.description: An action or a list of actions.

ActionSetEntry.description: One action set's meaning of an item (04 "Action sets").

Actions.description: Action set id → stages, or the stages directly (shorthand for `default`).

ui_language.description: BCP 47 tag; the OS locale when absent (17).

Behavior.description: Behavior (02). Numbers are checked against the settings registry.

when.description: Input pattern (04 "Pattern DSL"); parsed during validation.

BoardMonitor.description: primary, follow-pointer, a monitor index, or a monitor name.

radius.description: One radius, or `[top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left]`.

latched.description: A key name: a W3C code in any case (KeyA, F13) or an alias (q, shift, enter).

Filter.description: Point pipeline settings for one source (03 "PointPipeline").

Four_Length.description: One value for all four sides or corners, or a list of four.

Groups.description: A group name or a list of group names.

trigger_settings.description: Keyed by trigger id or switch alias.

Item.description: An item, a template (a partial item) or an empty grid cell (`- empty`).

empty.description: Holds a grid cell without an item.

zone.description: A game zone in a free layer (12).

Logging.description: Logging settings (11). Absent fields use the defaults in 11.

safety.description: Required (SAFETY-01); checked during validation so the message is exact.

Repeat.description: An action, a list of actions, or start (rerun the start sequence).

escape.description: Binding pattern that opens the Safe Board (SAFETY-01).

Style.description: The style keys a state, group or theme may set.
